title: RNA-seq of CD8+ T cells from JSLE patients and healthy controls
description: Transcriptional profiling of peripheral blood CD8+ T cells from juvenile systemic lupus erythematosus (JSLE) patients and healthy controls.

samples.title: AHC017CD8
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral blood was obtained by venipuncture, followed by PBMC isolation via Ficoll gradient. Cells were frozen in liquid nitrogen until use. Thawed PBMCs were sorted using FACS to select CD8+ T cells. PicoPure RNA extraction kit as per manufacturer's protocol TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library prep kit (Illumina cat. no. 20020595) OR KAPA mRNA HyperPrep Kit (Roche p/n KK8580), depending on sequencing batch

PicoPure RNA extraction kit as per manufacturer's protocol TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library prep kit (Illumina cat. no. 20020595) OR KAPA mRNA HyperPrep Kit (Roche p/n KK8580), depending on sequencing batch

runs.experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: RNA-seq of CD8+ T cells from JSLE patients and healthy controls
